work.name: Oligonucleotide analysis platform
work.expansion: In-house web app at GSK, known internally as MOSAIC
work.summary: A web app GSK's mass spectrometry scientists use to check the quality of oligonucleotide medicines (drugs made from short strands of DNA or RNA). Built to replace a mix of software packages, calculators and hand-built spreadsheets with one app that goes from the raw instrument file to the finished report.
points: Python and Flask app that reads Thermo Orbitrap raw files directly, with no manual export
Optimises instrument methods, sequences oligonucleotides, finds impurities and compares batches
Rules-based matching assigns each measured mass to the most likely structure within a ppm tolerance, then checks it against MS2 fragment ions and gives a confidence label
Exports straight to Excel, PDF and PowerPoint
Automated pytest suite, UI and output audit scripts, versioned releases and a standalone Windows build
work.result: Each analysis takes half the time, so the same team takes on twice as many projects.

work.name: Automated lab data pipeline
work.expansion: In-house tool at GSK, known internally as FIL (Fragment Ion Library)
work.summary: Runs on a schedule with no one touching it. It picks up new experiments from the lab's records system, pulls the chemical structures and instrument settings out of the attached slide decks, and loads them into a database built for searching.
points: Unattended scheduled job that pulls experiment records from Oracle and Databricks SQL
Parses the chemical structures embedded in slide decks with RDKit
Incremental, repeatable loads into a SQLite schema designed for the job, with a Streamlit app for browsing
work.result: Years of results that used to sit in slide decks are now searchable, with no manual steps.

work.name: EnteroBase
work.summary: Built an interactive web app for exploring data in EnteroBase, a public database of bacterial genomes, and integrated KleTy, an open-source pipeline for typing Klebsiella genomes, into it.
work.result: Part of EnteroBase, a public database with more than 4,200 active users.
